song_time_origin: song time = sample / 44100 in this PCM16 file (sample 0 = 0.000 s); 0-28 s rows scored=false

params.detector: superflux-style log-filterbank spectral flux with frequency max-filtered reference
params.downmix: mono = mean of channels, float scale [-1, 1) (int16 / 32768)
params.nfft_rule: next power of two >= 4 * window samples (zero padding; interpolates bins, adds no resolution)
params.frame_time_rule: signal front-padded by win/2 zeros, so frame k is centred on sample k*hop
params.filterbank: triangular, log-spaced 24 bands/octave, area-normalised, duplicate FFT bins merged (madmom unique_filters)
params.odf: sum over bands of max(0, L[k] - maxfilt3(L[k - mu]))
params.threshold: moving mean of ODF over +-thr_avg_s, plus delta (absolute ODF units)
params.band_group_rule: filterbank band assigned by centre frequency; high group capped at fmax; ODF from bands above 8 kHz reported as other_gt8k
params.context_rule: dense if median IOI over onsets within +-0.5 s is <= 0.160 s (needs >= 1 IOI), else sparse
params.over_sustain_rule: full-band mean-square dB of [t-200 ms, t) >= that of [t, t+200 ms) - 6 dB
params.prominence_rule: ODF[k] - min(ODF over the preceding 60 ms)

refinement.signal: first difference of the mono signal (transient emphasis)
refinement.estimate: argmax_n (E[n] - E[n - w]) in dB, minus w (the rise is maximal when the trailing window first lies wholly after the attack)

types.burst: 10 ms white noise x exp(-t / 3 ms), instantaneous start
types.kick: 5 ms sine glide 150 -> 60 Hz (exponential), phase 0 at start, x exp(-t / 2.5 ms)

plant_spec.level_rule: plant RMS over its own duration relative to host mono RMS over [t-200 ms, t+200 ms)
plant_spec.host_exclusion_rule: no host-only detection within +-40 ms, host detections taken at the smallest delta in the grid (largest host set)
plant_spec.match_rule: one-to-one, nearest detection within +-25 ms, error = detected - planted onset sample time

plant_validation.delta_rule: largest delta in DELTA_GRID for which BOOM 0-28 s set A gives recall >= 0.90 over plants >= -18 dB AND p95 |error| <= 6 ms over those matched plants (raw ODF frame time); chosen once, before any 28-75 s analysis, then frozen
plant_validation.delta_basis: fallback rule (primary rule unsatisfiable on the grid)
plant_validation.delta_fallback_rule: declared after the first sweep showed no grid value passes: take the largest delta whose set A recall(>= -18 dB) equals the grid maximum (most conservative delta at the best achievable recall). The recall requirement is then reported as FAILED, not relaxed.

refinement.signal: first difference of the mono signal (transient emphasis)
refinement.estimate: argmax_n (E[n] - E[n - w]) in dB, minus w (the rise is maximal when the trailing window first lies wholly after the attack)

plant_validation.refinement_choice_rule: use refined times if, on set A at the frozen delta, refined recall(>=-18) is not lower and refined p95 |err|(>=-18) is strictly lower than raw frame times

boom_A_dev.set: BOOM 0-28 s set A (development: delta + refinement chosen here)

strata_selected_timing.host_onsets_for_distance: host-only detections at the frozen delta

boom_B_holdout.set: BOOM 0-28 s set B (independent seed; not used for any choice)

strata_selected_timing.host_onsets_for_distance: host-only detections at the frozen delta

sonic.set: Sonic window 0.5-23.5 s (transfer; not used for any choice)

strata_selected_timing.host_onsets_for_distance: host-only detections at the frozen delta

red_test.rule: set B re-synthesised with every other plant omitted; detections scored against the FULL plant list
red_test.host_only_note: zero by construction: plants were placed >= 40 ms from host detections
red_test.chance_note: fraction of 2000 uniformly random times in 0.5-27.5 s lying within +-25 ms of a frozen-delta host onset: what an unexcluded plant could match by coincidence

alignment_check.method: log mean-square in exact 2 ms bins on each file's own time axis (rate independent), normalised cross-correlation over +-250 ms, parabolic sub-bin peak; plus 40 kHz waveform correlation (44.1 k mono resample_poly 400/441) and onset-level matching
alignment_check.sign: positive offset = replay later than the 44.1 kHz reference

ioi_107_110.annotation: later accents ~107-110 ms, compatible with ~109 ms sixteenths (provisional)

decay_vs_strong.annotation: stereo RMS ~-19.81 (50-55 s) vs ~-6.69 dBFS (55.5-75 s), 13.12 dB (provisional; computed on the float MP3 decode)

drop_cue_55p766.reference_note: drop-cue reference uses 10 ms band-energy half-rise per band, not spectral flux

negative_control_probes.rule: descriptive only; delta stays frozen at the BOOM 0-28 s choice
negative_control_probes.match_rule: one-to-one nearest within the stated tolerance; quiet_recovery scored on its 12 weak attacks only

sustain_false_birth_salience_floor.definition: max picked_up_to_delta among detections on sustain.s16 steady span 3-11 s at the frozen delta
sustain_false_birth_salience_floor.caution: the probe layer (pink noise + chord at REF) is not BOOM's sustained material; this floor is an engineering yardstick for noise-flux births, not a validated musical-salience threshold
